_note: Screen-from-marks verdicts (INTERACTIVE-AND-SHARING §A, §E, operator rulings §F, 2026-11-01). A template's verdict is derived: 'interactive' (the module declares interactive), 'screen' (its marks derive a working screen), or one of the paper-only verdicts listed HERE with a reason — writing (real writing practice: tracing, copying, cursive, drawing), many-answers (no single right answer), material (nothing to check: cards, cut-outs, charts). 'later' = eligible by the rule but its marks are not sufficient yet (the edit is named) — honest, and the gate counts it. A template with no verdict, or with two, fails scripts/makers/gates/screen-from-marks.js. Ids outside the built makers come from §E so later makers inherit their verdict.

writing.reason: real writing practice (tracing, copying, cursive, drawing) — typing cannot stand in for the motor act

many-answers.reason: more than one right answer: no key can mark it

material.reason: classroom material (cards, cut-outs, strips, charts) — nothing to check

later.reason: eligible, but the page's marks are not sufficient yet — the needed edit is named per id

levels._note: per-LEVEL paper-only verdicts for a template whose other levels have a screen: build-screens.js records the text as that level's screenReason (the level is simply not in screenLevels)

G2-411.1: many-answers: the array may be coloured anywhere on the grid, either way round

K-389.1: writing: level 1 traces the dashed word in each gap

K-454.3: many-answers: level 3 finds the ways to make 10 itself — any five of them are right

G2-472.3: writing: level 3 draws the coins that make each price (any coins that make it are right)

K-540.1: material: level 1 is a chart to read — consonant + vowel = syllable, nothing to answer
K-540.3: writing: level 3 traces each syllable on school lines
